what: Plan allowlists hyphen Codex JSONL in committed run logs but does not update SECURITY.md
scenario_or_breakage: SECURITY.md states raw Codex --json streams (*.events.jsonl) are session-local and excluded from larch-logs publication; after the PR, *-codex-events.jsonl would be publishable while policy text still claims all Codex JSONL event streams stay tmpdir-only
